anchors.definition: first 1s bar whose high/low reaches entry +/- x*atr_entry_1m, strictly before the terminal flip; features through that bar inclusive

decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE_MECHANICAL_BASELINE: a level residual passes with no primary variable explaining it, OR replication MDE > 0.10 at every anchor for the primary tests, OR the engine null cannot be built
decision_rule.LOCATION_ONLY: no primary variable passes on any residual outcome AND the A level residual vs N1c does not pass AND the B level residual vs N3 does not pass (raw speed separation may remain)
decision_rule.PATH_INFORMATION_PRESENT: any PRIMARY variable passes discovery+replication on A residual-vs-N2, B residual-vs-N3, or giveback residual-vs-N3
decision_rule.critical: if A shows no meaningful residual from (x+1)/3 and the B residual disappears against N3 (the causal flip-trigger mechanics), the verdict is LOCATION_ONLY even if raw speed separation remains

flip_trigger.definition: long: min(EMA3_low, EMA9_low); short: max(EMA3_high, EMA9_high) of completed 1m bars, engine state after the last completed minute; loosest completed-close that could flip (a flip also needs the bar's own low/high absorbed); intrabar never flips
features: trig_rel_entry (A, + = above entry in trade direction)

nulls.N1_analytic: driftless continuous path between fixed barriers: P = (x+1)/3 at the nominal anchor x; N1c uses the anchor bar close location (overshoot-aware): (cur+1)/3
nulls.N2_bootstrap_fixed: per event, 64 driftless paths: 30 s blocks of the preceding 3600 s of real 1s bars (relative OHLC), sign-symmetrised per block, started from the anchor bar close, same OHLC touch semantics; quantifies discrete-bar/tick/overshoot/local-volatility corrections to N1
nulls.N3_engine_terminal: the same simulated paths aggregated into real-clock 1m bars (the partial current minute included) and fed through features/trackers/regime_dual_ema.py semantics initialised with the replayed real engine state at the anchor; gives P(+2A before flip), P(giveback | +2A), P(win)
nulls.no_diffusion_baseline: a fitted drift/vol diffusion is not built: N2 already preserves local volatility causally and a fitted drift would reintroduce the effect under test
nulls.role: N1 is THE fixed-race null (N2 reports corrections); N3 is THE terminal-race null (moving endogenous boundary); never substituted for each other

outcomes.A_fixed_race: from the anchor bar onward: +2A (from entry) touched before -1A; eligible only if -1A not touched at/before the anchor bar; same-bar both = ambiguous (excluded); unresolved by session close = censored (excluded)
outcomes.B_terminal_race: +2A touched strictly before the opposite 1m flip (audited reach_fav_2p0)

population: the 6,024 audited 2023 development trades of nq_post_entry_path_mechanism_2023; final 20% dark; 2024-2026 untouched
robustness: for primary effects that pass (else the largest |delta| primary per outcome, descriptively): long/short, initial MTF states with >= 150 events, RTH segments

statistics.level_residual: per anchor: mean(y) - mean(null) (A vs N1, N1c, N2; B vs N3); session-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 1000 reps, seed 20260927
statistics.path_effect: per anchor x primary variable: tercile cutpoints fixed on the DISCOVERY block at that anchor; delta = mean(y - null_event) in top tercile - bottom tercile; A uses N2 per event, B uses N3 per event, giveback uses N3 P(giveback|+2A) (anchor 2.0: 1 - N3 P(win)); raw (y-only) deltas also reported to show what the nulls absorb
statistics.power: MDE (80% power, two-sided 5%) for a top-vs-bottom tercile difference: 2.80 * sqrt(p(1-p)*(3/N + 3/N)) * sqrt(1.3 design effect), p = block outcome rate; reported per anchor/block/outcome BEFORE effects are read
statistics.speed_controls: time_to_anchor delta = N-weighted mean of within-segment deltas over RTH segments [08:30-10:30), [10:30-13:30), [13:30-close) CT; sensitivity: exclude anchors < 3600 s before session close
statistics.trigger_conditioning: B raw speed delta vs B residual-vs-N3 speed delta, and within trig_rel_entry terciles

thresholds.discovery_pass: meaningful at >= 2 ADJACENT anchors for the same variable and outcome
thresholds.level_residual_pass: meaningful at >= 2 adjacent anchors in discovery AND same sign with >= half magnitude in replication
thresholds.replication_pass: at those anchors, replication deltas have the same sign and mean |delta_rep| >= 0.5 * mean |delta_disc|, with replication MDE <= 0.10 at those anchors

variables.secondary_rule: secondary variables are reported and can never determine PATH_INFORMATION_PRESENT
